description: This file provides type definitions for the Node.js 'string_decoder' module, including the StringDecoder class and module declarations. It includes documentation and code examples illustrating usage of the class.

classes.name: StringDecoder
classes.description: A class providing an API to decode Buffer objects into strings while preserving multibyte character boundaries.

methods.name: constructor(encoding?: BufferEncoding); constructor
methods.description: Creates a new StringDecoder instance with the specified encoding, defaulting to 'utf8'.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Decodes a given Buffer or string input, preserving incomplete multibyte characters for the next call.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Returns any remaining decoded string, optionally processing a final buffer, and resets the internal buffer state.
